	<ResortReportHeadline>7cms fresh and still snowing lightly!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>There has been a nice little refresh over the last couple of days. This morning we've got a further 7cms of new snow to add to yesterday's tally, bringing the total to 11cms so far from this system.</p><p>At 6am it's still snowing lightly which is forecast to continue on and off throughout the day. The current temp is -2.5, headed for a top of -1 degrees and the wind is light to moderate from the NW.</p><p>At the moment the snow feels reasonably dry underfoot and should make for some really fun turns with the best of it being had early before there's any temperature rise.</p><p>The groomers will be in great shape from the outset, perfect for arcing some turns. Off piste is a little more tricky to read. I reckon some areas will have accumulated enough snow for some smooth turns, however, you might still be feeling the hard base underneath on ridge tops and some of the steeper terrain so be sure to feel it out before diving in.</p><p>There are signs of significant promise beginning to show in the long range forecast and next week could be very interesting. Stay tuned to see how this develops over the coming days.....</p><p>Have a great day out there! Cheers, Burner.</p></ResortReport>
